# Create Real Matrix From Eigenvalues

![Create Real Matrix From Eigenvalues function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/02-real_matrix_from_eigenvalues.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Builds a real companion matrix from a monic polynomial with the supplied roots: unit superdiagonal and final row of negated ascending coefficients. Non-real roots require conjugate partners with preserved multiplicities. Inputs calculate in DBL/CDB with explicit numeric promotion; 64-bit integers above 2^53 may round. No broadcasting, no private Matrix reinterpretation. error is I32 and never an automatic dialog. Optional unwired defaults: none.

<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Create Real Matrix From Eigenvalues**

Construit une matrice compagnon réelle à partir des valeurs propres données. Les racines complexes doivent apparaître par paires conjuguées ; aucune partie imaginaire n’est effacée. Valeurs facultatives non câblées : none.

</details>
